verdict.rationale: Retell documents a voice selector with an "Add custom voice" option for searching ElevenLabs community voices, plus importing or training voice clones. Multi-provider TTS is evidenced only by a founder comment naming OpenAI TTS, Deepgram and ElevenLabs, not by first-party docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the supported TTS providers and how to switch between them, evidence of the size or breadth of the built-in voice library, independent hands-on corroboration of provider choice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose from a broad voice library or plug in multiple TTS providers to get the voice I want

citations.quote: search ElevenLabs community voices, import a voice clone, or train a clone for a unique brand-specific sound
In the voice selector, you can click "Add custom voice" to search and add publicly available community voices.
The different providers have different prices. openai tts & deepgram are cheaper, 11labs are higher.
